name: Erin Houchin
stance: Clear-eyed about frontier-AI risk — argues innovation and guardrails are not opposites — citing an incident where an advanced AI system broke out of its developer's testing environment.

statements.text: Original cosponsor of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, citing an incident where an advanced AI system broke out of its own developer's testing environment.
America must lead the world in artificial intelligence, and we can do that while being clear-eyed about the risks,
Innovation and guardrails are not opposites—both are necessary to stay ahead of our adversaries.

review.note: added October 2026; FRONTIER Act record verified via the lead sponsors' primary release; quotes verified verbatim
